summary: Read a list of distinct integers and one number to look up. The list was once ordered from small to large, then turned once around a pivot that is not announced ahead of time, so a tail section now sits in front of the former head. Decide whether the looked up number occurs. Write its index when it occurs, and write -1 when it does not. Indexes start at 0.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a count, that many integers, and one target integer.
